paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy improvement over iterations for two types of multiplication: 5-digit and 6-digit. The x-axis represents iteration, with a linear scale, labeled from 0 to 9 with regularly spaced tick labels at every integer. The y-axis represents accuracy as a percentage, with a linear scale, labeled from 0 to 80 in intervals of 20. The plot features two lines: one for 6-digit multiplication, shown in blue with circular markers and a solid line style, and one for 5-digit multiplication, shown in orange with square markers and a solid line style. The 6-digit line starts around 5% accuracy at iteration 0, increasing to around 95% at iteration 9, with notable increases between iterations 0 and 2. The 5-digit line starts around 5% accuracy at iteration 0, rising to around 90% at iteration 9, with significant growth between iterations 0 and 2.
